Nora V: Hi everyone  first day remote. Laptop and monitor arrived but the USB-C cable in the monitor box is a power-only cable (no data) so the display stays "No signal" when plugged into the dock. Also at my neighborhood cafe I can only see RedwoodGuest SSID and Okta keeps timing out. Opening INC-13131. Any quick help?

Eli (IT): Welcome Nora! Sorry about the cable. Can you quickly check the cable ends  are they labeled 'USB-C 5A' or anything saying 'PD only'? If it's power-only the vendor shipped the wrong part. For the cafe: we usually whitelist the public IP for the SSO step temporarily. Do you have the cafe's public IP or can you share a screenshot of the wifi list?

Nora V: Cable label just says "USB-C" and has tiny text "2.4A"  I suspect it's the low-power one. Cafe SSID is "Bean & Byte" and public IP from whatismyip.org is 44.55.66.77. I can plug into the dock and send a short video of the monitor behavior if that helps.

Eli (IT): 2.4A definitely sounds like power-only. Yup please send the video. I'll kick off a same-day courier with a 100W USB-C data cable and an HDMI adapter just in case. Also I'll add a temp firewall exception for 44.55.66.77 so you can complete Okta SSO right now.

Nora V: Video: https://imgur.com/monitor_video_xyz  thanks for the quick response. I'm in the middle of the HR onboarding call though  if you can do the SSO exception that'd be huge.

auth-bot: INC-13131 created by Nora V; priority: P2; assignee: Eli (IT).

Eli (IT): Temporary exception applied for 44.55.66.77 for 90 minutes. Quick VPN install for Mac if you haven't yet:
```bash
# macOS
curl -O https://internal.redwood/downloads/secureconnect.dmg
open secureconnect.dmg
# Sign in with Okta SSO when prompt appears
```
If Okta still times out paste the error text here and I'll remote in.

ship-bot: INC-13131 shipping label created: courier will deliver 100W USB-C data cable + HDMI adapter today PM. Tracking: UPS 1ZZA12345678901234.

People Ops: Welcome @Nora V :tada: If the courier needs a signature we have the home address on file. Also ping me if you want a buddy intro after your HR call.

Nora V: Okta sign-in worked after the exception, VPN connected, and I can access internal docs. Huge relief  thanks Eli. Courier ETA looks like 6pm which works.

Eli (IT): Great. I'll keep INC-13131 open until you confirm the cable swap and the monitor is stable. If the replacement cable doesn't fix it we'll swap the monitor. Also re: HDMI adapter  if you need us to preconfigure display scaling tell me the desired resolution and I'll set that on the replacement image.

Nora V: Thanks, Eli  prefer 2560x1440 scaling 100%. Will confirm after cable arrives. Off to the HR session now :wave:
